Schnittstelle Foldable<A>

Typparameter:
A - the element type being folded
Alle Superschnittstellen:
FoldableLeft<A>, FoldableRight<A>
public interface Foldable<A> extends FoldableLeft<A>, FoldableRight<A>

A data type whose elements can be aggregated (reduced) using a folding function.

This interface unifies FoldableLeft and FoldableRight and allows both left‑ and right‑associative folds. Implementations should document order, strictness (eager vs. lazy), and null‑safety guarantees.
